analysis.rationale: Net profit surged 235% YoY despite weak optical fibre cable market, indicating strong operational performance and diversification. Early signs of recovery in optical fibre cable market and robust demand outlook support positive momentum.
analysis.summary: Birla Cable reported standalone net profit of ₹16.87 crore for FY2025-26, up 235% from ₹5.03 crore in FY2024-25, driven by strong Structured LAN Cable sales.
